class_name: 過去-回想-タコトガアル類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Reports experience accumulated at some unspecified point in one's life rather than a particular past event, so it is avoided for something that just happened (昨日読んだことがある sounds off; plain 読んだ is what you want). The negative, often with 一度も, is the standard way to say you have never done something. Swapping the particle shifts the emphasis: 〜たことはある concedes, 〜たこともある adds to a list.

examples.ruby: 北海道[ほっかいどう]でスキーをしたことがある。
examples.english: I've been skiing in Hokkaido before.

examples.ruby: 夏祭[なつまつ]りで金魚[きんぎょ]をすくったことがあります。
examples.english: I've scooped goldfish at a summer festival before.

examples.ruby: 一度[いちど]も飛行機[ひこうき]に乗[の]り遅[おく]れたことはありません。
examples.english: I have never once missed a flight.
